title: Concept: Registry index fetched over cleartext
description: .cargo/config.toml declares a registry `index` over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a registry `index` over cleartext.
